TRANSPOSE of a MATRIX
 The transpose of a matrix swaps its rows with columns. 

For a 2x2 matrix A 

if A = [a11 a12]
 [a21 a22]

the transpose is A^T = [a11 a21]
 [a12 a22].

Consider a 3x3 matrix A = [a11 a12 a13]
 [a21 a22 a23]
 [a31 a32 a33].
The transpose is: A^T = [a11 a21 a31]
 [a12 a22 a32]
 [a13 a23 a33]
